annotations.title: Purchase an appraisal within a funded grant

description: Buy the existing current_appraisal service using a prepaid account and an operator's existing spending grant. Connect with Authorization: Bearer ad_agent_<token>; never put credentials in arguments. Supply an explicit operationId, grantId, domain and maxSpendUsd. The original purchase route enforces authentication, expiry, domain/product permissions, balance, grant limits and the shared engine budget. One purchase invocation per MCP request; retain the receipt. Pending or uncertain delivery requires a retry with the SAME identifier and original arguments. This tool cannot fund the account, create grants or raise a limit. Configuration does not guarantee live readiness; the route's response is authoritative.

maxSpendUsd.description: Explicit maximum USD-equivalent service-credit spend for this operation; no inferred or automatically increased ceiling.

operationId.description: Caller-chosen purchase identifier. Persist it before calling and reuse it with the original arguments after a lost reply; never generate a new identifier for a retry.
